name: skippy-quality
title: Skippy Quality: one module, the best quality
author: Skippy
description: One quality module in a machine makes everything it produces the highest quality you have researched, at a cost in time: a tier 1 module triples the time of each craft, tier 2 doubles it, tier 3 adds half, and a better module quality slows less. No churning through the tiers. More than one quality module adds only slowness; with Skippy Copilot the extras are taken out.
